description: Source file implementing the XNAP network gateway factory and related notifiers for SCTP communication in a 3GPP-like environment, including classes for handling SCTP associations, message packing/unpacking, and connection management.

classes.name: no_assoc_xnc_to_gw_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for initial XNAP message to establish SCTP association, handles packing and forwarding of the initial message.

classes.name: xnc_to_gw_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for outgoing XNAP messages, packs and forwards messages over SCTP.

classes.name: gw_to_xnc_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for incoming SCTP SDUs, unpacks and forwards XNAP messages to the CU-CP.

classes.name: xnc_sctp_server
classes.description: Implements SCTP server and connection management for XNAP gateway, handling connection setup and message forwarding.

methods.name: get_init_tx_notifier
methods.description: Returns notifier for initial message transmission to establish SCTP association.

methods.name: attach_cu_cp
methods.description: Attaches CU-CP handler and starts listening for SCTP connections.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the SCTP server is listening on.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SCTP association notifier for a given connection.
